item.title: Version 0.2.7
item.description:
What's New

  • DiffStore — extracted diff caching and preloading into a proper ViewModel
  • Preload diffs — first 10 files on change selection, neighbors on file click
  • DiffEdit context collapsing — hides unchanged lines, shared Rust implementation
  • Menu icons — SF Symbols on all menus: DAG context, Repository, Format, Help
  • DAG context menu separators — grouped by action type
  • Right-click target highlight — shows which commit "selected onto this" targets
  • Clean Up Stale Bookmarks in Repository menu
  • Protocol-based menu system — reliable in all window types
  • Toast HUD dismisses on click
  • Favicon for jayjay.hewig.dev

Performance

  • DiffEdit skips reload when scrolling (cached state check)
  • DiffEdit reuses DiffStore cache for file content

Cleanup

  • Removed EscapeDismisser, replaced DispatchQueue delays with Task.sleep
  • Removed SwiftUI @FocusedValue system, unified via ActiveRepoTracker
  • Unified Rust collapse_context into single implementation

item.title: Version 0.2.6
item.description:
What's New

  • Auto-track remote bookmarks on git fetch/pull
  • Rebase selected onto context menu action
  • Immutable-aware context menu — hides destructive actions for immutable commits
  • Config check on repo open — alerts when user.name/email not set
  • Working copy auto-sync — library transactions properly sync files on disk
  • Redesigned Jujutsu settings — grouped sections with icons

Performance

  • O(n) diff algorithm — fixes 10s+ Cargo.lock diff
  • File list performance — cached review state and tree building
  • Skip syntax highlighting for .lock/.csv/.svg files

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed jj edit crash: "Descendants have not been rebased"
  • Fixed jj new deleting files from target commit
  • Fixed false config warning when user.name/email are set
  • Updated bookmark track syntax (fixes deprecation warnings)
